sentences.en: If anything, the economy in our country is going up.
sentences.zh: 1. 如果有的话，我们国家的经济正在上升。

sentences.en: That amount of crops isn't enough to support their economy.
sentences.zh: 2. 那么少的农作物不足以支撑他们的经济。

sentences.en: The U.S. economy is the largest in the world.
sentences.zh: 3. 美国经济是世界上最大的。
